Build

Telemetry
    $ python3 infra/deploy/nano_deploy.py --data-root <TMP>/home/.local/share/aware-care-demo power-sampler
    It adds this line to your crontab once (it keeps the GPU power sampler running for the telemetry page):
    * * * * * /usr/bin/flock -n <TMP>/home/.local/share/aware-care-demo/telemetry/sampler.lock /usr/bin/python3 <TMP>/home/.local/share/aware-care-demo/telemetry/power_sampler.py --out <TMP>/home/.local/share/aware-care-demo/data/local/power >> <TMP>/home/.local/share/aware-care-demo/telemetry/sampler.log 2>&1

Open it
  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  │ On your computer, keep this tunnel open:
  │   ssh -N -p 2222 -L 18180:127.0.0.1:8180 alice@192.0.2.3
  │ Then open:  http://127.0.0.1:18180
  │ (localhost works too; then choose Presenter or Patient)
  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Status: ./demo.sh status    Stop: ./demo.sh stop

nano-model.stdout:
Aware Care · serve the model with ZRT on HP ZGX Nano · dry run
<VERSION>

Checks
  ✓ Device: ZGX Nano (--device)
  ✓ Nothing for an administrator to do (login session, lingering)

Model
  ✓ CUDA toolchain: <TMP>/cuda-root/cuda-13.3
    Download: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8@95a723d08a9490559dae23d0cff1d9466213d989, about 37.49 GB (once; ZRT keeps it in its cache)
    $ <TMP>/bin/zrt -m system pull hf:Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8@95a723d08a9490559dae23d0cff1d9466213d989

Install
    $ install -D -m 644 infra/nano/zrt/aware-care-zrt-model.service <TMP>/home/.config/systemd/user/aware-care-zrt-model.service
    $ install -D -m 755 infra/nano/zrt/serve-model.sh <TMP>/home/.local/share/aware-care-demo/zrt/serve-model.sh
    $ install -D -m 755 infra/zrt/model-watchdog.sh <TMP>/home/.local/share/aware-care-demo/zrt/model-watchdog.sh
    $ install -D -m 644 infra/nano/zrt/aware-care-zrt-watchdog.service <TMP>/home/.config/systemd/user/aware-care-zrt-watchdog.service
    $ install -D -m 644 infra/nano/zrt/aware-care-zrt-watchdog.timer <TMP>/home/.config/systemd/user/aware-care-zrt-watchdog.timer
    $ AWARECARE_MODEL_REVISION=95a723d08a9490559dae23d0cff1d9466213d989 in <TMP>/home/.config/aware-care-demo/model.env (other lines kept)
    $ systemctl --user daemon-reload

Start
    $ systemctl --user enable aware-care-zrt-model.service
    $ systemctl --user restart --no-block aware-care-zrt-model.service
    $ rm -f <TMP>/home/.local/share/aware-care-demo/zrt/watchdog.state
    $ systemctl --user enable --now aware-care-zrt-watchdog.timer
    Model start: about 6 min here; a first start in a fresh ZRT takes up to 25 min (it builds the GPU kernels).
    Dry run: nothing was downloaded, installed or started.
